name: Iatros
appearance: Clean and carefully groomed, with gentle hands and an attentive expression. He wears a pristine white chiton with a narrow purple border, cinched with a cord belt from which hangs a small leather medical bag. His dark hair is neatly trimmed, and he carries a wooden staff topped with a carved snake - the symbol of healing. Small clay vials of herbs peek from his belt pouch, and his movements are precise yet comforting.
